retired_reason: Owner approved the work as done, but the feature's goal is unachievable: GitHub retired GitHub Models on 2026-07-30. It was built in commit 71cf488 and removed in commit 6c806d6. Marking this DONE would assert a live provider that does not exist, so the record is CANCELLED instead. The service is dead while models.github.ai still answers HTTP 200 with the body OK, so a status-code health check falsely passes; see D-002 for the recorded evidence and reasoning.
